title: Virtual Sharp
description: Defines a virtual sharp: the theoretical corner point where two edges (or their apparent extensions) intersect, drawn as a small cross mark.

edge1.description: First defining edge (linear or linear-apparent). Required on create; optional on edit (the current edge is kept when omitted). Omitted on export when the referenced edge can no longer be determined.

edge2.description: Second defining edge (linear or linear-apparent); its intersection with edge1 gives the virtual sharp point. Required on create; optional on edit (the current edge is kept when omitted). Omitted on export when the referenced edge can no longer be determined.

position.description: The virtual intersection point (read-only, computed from edge1 and edge2).
